name: q01_select_all
sql: SELECT id, name, val FROM t ORDER BY id

name: q02_where_equality
sql: SELECT id, name FROM t WHERE id = 2

name: q03_where_greater_than
sql: SELECT id, val FROM t WHERE val > 20.0 ORDER BY id

name: q04_where_is_null
sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE val IS NULL ORDER BY id

name: q05_where_is_not_null
sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id

name: q06_count_all
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t

name: q07_count_column_skips_null
sql: SELECT COUNT(val) FROM t

name: q08_sum_column
sql: SELECT SUM(val) FROM t

name: q09_avg_column
sql: SELECT AVG(val) FROM t

name: q10_min_max
sql: SELECT MIN(val), MAX(val) FROM t

name: q11_group_by_sum
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY grp ORDER BY grp

name: q12_group_by_having
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) FROM sales GROUP BY grp HAVING SUM(amount) > 120.0 ORDER BY grp

name: q13_inner_join
sql: SELECT l.id, l.name, r.score FROM l JOIN r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id

name: q14_left_join
sql: SELECT l.id, l.name, r.score FROM l LEFT JOIN r ON l.id = r.id ORDER BY l.id

name: q15_order_by_desc
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id DESC

name: q16_order_by_nulls_first
sql: SELECT id, val FROM t ORDER BY val NULLS FIRST, id

name: q17_order_by_nulls_last
sql: SELECT id, val FROM t ORDER BY val NULLS LAST, id

name: q18_limit_offset
sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1

name: q19_arithmetic_expressions
sql: SELECT id, id + 10, id * 2 FROM t WHERE id <= 2 ORDER BY id

name: q20_three_valued_logic
sql: SELECT NULL AND FALSE, NULL OR TRUE, NULL = NULL

name: q21_case_when
sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN id < 3 THEN 'low' ELSE 'high' END AS category FROM t WHERE id <= 3 ORDER BY id

name: q22_cast_expression
sql: SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR), CAST(val AS INT64) FROM t WHERE id = 1

name: q23_like_expression
sql: SELECT name FROM t WHERE name LIKE 'a%'

name: q24_not_operator
sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE NOT (id > 2) ORDER BY id

name: q25_distinct_aggregate
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT grp) FROM sales

name: q26_empty_aggregate
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(val) FROM t WHERE id > 100

name: q27_join_with_null_keys
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l JOIN r ON l.id = r.id

name: q28_multiple_aggregates_group_by
sql: SELECT g, SUM(v), COUNT(v), COUNT(*) FROM t_nulls GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

name: q29_between_via_and
sql: SELECT id FROM t WHERE id >= 2 AND id <= 4 ORDER BY id

name: q30_literals_select
sql: SELECT 42, 'hello', TRUE
